## Objective
- Improve the existing game’s graphics and gameplay, and fix camera switching so the selected feed updates without closing and reopening the tablet.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing game and make it playable; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for visual checks and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Add camera navigation, motion indicators, power warnings, and an audio lure.
- Upgrade lighting, materials, room details, and animatronic models.

## Work State

### Completed
- Added camera switching with immediate feed redraw, previous/next controls, arrow-key cycling, number-key selection, and clickable floor-plan rooms.
- Added motion indicators, power warnings, an audio lure with cooldown and sound effects, and gameplay/AI adjustments.
- Integrated the rewritten camera-feed character renderer into `src/feeds.js`.
- Ran `node --check` successfully on all six JavaScript source files and `git diff --check`.
- Verified in Playwright that selecting camera `1B` updates `game.cam` and `feed.cam` without reopening the tablet; browser session had zero console errors and four warnings.
- Read the latest screenshot, `screenshots/feed_canvas.jpg`.

### Active
- Continue the graphics overhaul and browser verification of camera navigation, lure, controls, and night completion.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the visual quality shown in `screenshots/feed_canvas.jpg` and continue browser checks for gameplay and controls.
2. Fix any issues discovered, save a new small JPEG screenshot, and read only that latest screenshot.
3. Review `git diff` and report final verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `src/feeds.js`: camera scenes and camera-feed character renderer.
- `src/main.js`: UI wiring, controls, HUD, and immediate camera updates.
- `src/game.js`: AI, camera state, lure, power, and night logic.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js scene and visual overhaul.
- `src/textures.js`: procedural textures and materials.
- `src/audio.js`: lure and other game audio.
- `index.html`: game UI and camera controls.
- `styles.css`: HUD and camera UI styling.
- `screenshots/feed_canvas.jpg`: latest camera-feed visual check.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; modified files include `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `src/{audio,feeds,game,main,textures,world}.js`.
- No `package.json` was found in the repository.
